Replaced the unsupported type name by the subgroup preserving the two specified blocks, with explicit empty-block and label-shift conventions and the unique-restriction identification.

Replaced F4 and its direct dependency by the actual published basis proposition and explained extension to a complex basis, the field used in step 4.1. Also repaired F5 to cite the corrected block-preserving subgroup definition.
